title: Uqrat tan Aamanti
intro: opulent hall of power, kufri kee qanxaffe elle sugteh tan aracal, dubuk yan numma xongolo qammalsime wayta aracal yabte. ta muuci gexkalit reedanti farmoyti kalaloonuh, ken amni kasaara numma yaysixxigoonuh.
clues: Anu kaxxa qanxaffe le baaxol mannoowak, rabbiino inta miraacah ayfaf acayuk suge.
Anu inni nummâ mabla mango sanootah qelliseh suge, ken baxxaqisaanam katassah tan xalootuk meysitak.
farmoyti qado astooti luk yamaate wak, anu aamineh, takkay immay yi ummatta kaal celsis abte.
Anu qanxaffele num kee kay mala buxak foocal sooleh, oson currik yan farmoyti qidaanam mafaxxinta axcuk qadaaqadisak.
Anu Nuuc kee Qaadih ummattah innah tan numma cineh taturte agattiinaanih digaalak ken diggoseh.
Yalli ken uma cogdah yoo catteh, zulmi xintoh gacsi sumaaqiteh.

arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verse: So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment - (40:45)
